formation.explanation: A proposer reaches the current leader directly or via follower forwarding. Leader assigns term/index, checks quota and configuration serialization, then appends and replicates. Follower validates the prior term/index and never overwrites committed entries; successful append responses and leader self acknowledgments wait for durable storage. Leader tracks Match per peer, aggregates only configured voters (both majorities in joint state), and commits a quorum-supported index only if it belongs to its term. Append/heartbeat propagates commitment, with heartbeat commit bounded by each follower Match. Ready delivers committed entries in order and completion responses advance applied and release quota. Rejection, heartbeat retry and snapshot fallback repair lagging support.

context.explanation: A promotable node without unapplied committed configuration changes campaigns, optionally pre-voting. Votes require up-to-date history and compatible term/vote state; persisted replies are aggregated under installed voters. Winning becomes leader and appends a current-term empty entry. Higher terms normally become follower; pre-vote and active-lease checks have explicit exceptions. Reset clears volatile votes, progress, read-only support and transfer target but retains log/commit. Same-term leader traffic ends candidacy; old-term traffic cannot count as fresh replication support. Transfer temporarily blocks proposals, catches up its target and sends TimeoutNow; timeout clears transfer without changing role. Applying configuration updates quorum authority; snapshot/restart restore it.

connection.explanation: Eligible support depends jointly on current term and installed membership. Role reset discards volatile replication/vote support, but retained committed history restricts future vote eligibility and append acceptance. Joint membership requires old and new majorities; applying a configuration can itself make more entries quorum-supported. Deferred storage acknowledgments are qualified by term, with committed snapshot/application completions surviving authority change. Pending proposal success is not guaranteed; proposals during transfer are dropped. Safe read support is rebuilt after reset and gated on current-term commit; queued pre-commit requests are separately released later. Application of committed membership plus applied progress conditionally initiates automatic exit; proposal acceptance is still governed by current authority/transfer state. Transfer cancellation alone supplies no application-triggered retry; caught-up heartbeat processing does not call appliedTo. Later application and new leadership remain separate continuation triggers. Status copies configuration through Clone and does not mutate live authority.

grounding.derivation: ReadOnlySafe obtains read authority by communicating with a quorum. The local singleton exception is valid because the local voter is then a quorum itself, as IsSingleton documentation assumes. MajorityConfig counts only IDs in its voter set. When the local responder is absent and no communication occurs, it has no eligible voter support for the fresh request; role state alone cannot supply it. Optional step-down changes behavior but does not weaken the separately selected ReadOnlySafe guarantee. This is a necessary support condition, not a guarantee of read completion or an equality requiring success.
grounding.applicability: Fresh request after actual applied removal, singleton voter other than responder, no network input to responder through returned Ready.
alternatives: Enabling step-down protects this history; dropping or forwarding the request without producing unsupported ReadState is permitted.
Application wait may prevent an immediate client read, but does not provide missing quorum support for this library-issued barrier.
